visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera begins a slow, steady pan across a wooden floor in a modern living room setting. Several women are seen lying on the floor in various states of sleep. In the foreground, a woman in a black mini-skirt and fishnets is lying on her side. To her right, another woman in denim shorts and a white top is curled up. The background contains a black leather sofa and cardboard boxes. (2) The pan continues to the right, showing more women splayed across the floorboards. One woman is resting her head on a bright green owl-shaped plushie. The lighting is warm and bright, coming from indoor sources. The setting is clean and well-maintained. (3) The camera movement finishes by showing a woman in a beige bodycon dress lying on a wooden bench built into the wall. A yellow smiley face pillow with the word 'drew' is visible next to her. She lies still with her eyes closed, completing the scene of the group being completely exhausted.
